_note: World frame = Piper base frame (x forward, z up), units m/deg. Edit this to match the physical setup, then restart the simulation window.

piper._joint_offsets_note: New firmware (piper_sdk dh_is_offset=1) uses [0,2,-2,0,0,0]; set all to 0 for old firmware

tool._note: Clipper: a cylinder that sticks out 6 cm beyond the gripper fingertips in simulation, diameter = fingertip height of about 2.5 cm. tip_offset_m = clipper tip position relative to the Piper flange (link6) (fingertips 0.14 m + 0.06 m); it is also the teleoperation control point: the tip follows the leader end effector. The gripper is locked and does not follow the leader

hair._note: Hair only on the rear of the top and the back of the head, forward to the ears (head center line): front_hairline_frac is the hairline position (0 = head center line at the ears, 1 = frontmost forehead), down to min_height_frac (top of the ears). Haircut regions = top (above top_frac) / back / left / right. cover_radius_m = how close the clipper tip must be to the hair to count as cut

camera._note: Main view: with follow_tip=true the look-at point follows the clipper tip (between it and the leader end effector when cutting the back/top; larger follow_leader_weight biases it toward the leader). With follow_region=true, when the tip is closer than region_switch_distance_m to the hair of a region, the view turns to that region's region_views angle; dragging with the mouse pauses this for manual_pause_s seconds. Press F in the window to toggle follow/free

region_views._note: [angle of the side of the head the camera is on (from the face direction, 180 = directly behind, positive = the person's left), elevation]

calibration._note: fit_yaw=false: calibration solves only the position; orientation comes from head.euler_deg (-90 = face pointing away from Piper)

real_camera._note: Real camera: opens a preview window next to the MuJoCo window and is composited to the right of the MuJoCo view when recording. index 1 = the camera facing the head and Piper (0 is the laptop's built-in one); enabled=false disables it

views._note: The two small simulated views in the window and recording. gripper = gripper view (camera back_m behind and up_m above the tip, gripper semi-transparent with see_through_alpha); hair_map = haircut progress view looking at the hair from behind and above the head
